title.zh: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
title.en: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit

current_state.zh: The Liquid Network resumed block production after deploying emergency software updates following a $320 million Bitcoin withdrawal exploit, though transactions and peg operations remain suspended during recovery.
current_state.en: The Liquid Network resumed block production after deploying emergency software updates following a $320 million Bitcoin withdrawal exploit, though transactions and peg operations remain suspended during recovery.
